reason: My cousin's installer already did his house and I can see it working, and when I want prices I ask in the Khartoum solar Facebook group where real people answer. An app I've never heard of doesn't feel safer than that, so this month I'd just get a quote from my cousin's guy.
objection: I don't know who is behind SunXFinder or how they pick these companies. Anyone can say 'ratings only from real customers', and I worry that once my request is out my number will end up with salesmen anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If people in my Facebook group posted that SunXFinder checked their quote and caught a fake battery or an overpriced inverter, I'd send them my cousin's installer's quote to check for free.
